main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 5-bar forward return on forecast, in-profile grid bars, coins pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting difference > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return, forecast > 0 minus forecast = 0 (Welch)

decided_by: Inconclusive: the slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: In-profile grid bars are those where the vol_dryup component is recorded; the normal drift is the coin's mean 5-bar return over the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; the slope's t is the OLS slope over its standard error; the supporting check passes when the difference is above 0, its Welch t being reported.
